thread:
sara: FYI - after the fw tighten earlier today eu-west GPU nodes failed to finish boot because keystore decrypts timed out. warmup latency up ~10m for new nodes.
dan: which fw rule? the new SNI inspect or the strict egress deny we rolled last night?
linh: SNI inspection + tightened egress; keystore traffic was being rewritten and created a pile of NAT sessions. conntrack peaked ~68k which exhausted available tracking capacity and caused intermittent TCP timeouts.
michael: saw this in metrics: kubelet join latency spike -> node marked NotReady -> drain loops.
ops-bot: alert: firewall-canary returned 504 for auditshipper service in eu-west at 09:12 UTC.
sara: immediate mitigation we applied: - allowlist keystore s3 IPs in SG for auditshipper hosts, - set local audit sampling to 5% for warmup windows, - temporarily enable privatelink to keystore proxy.
dan: important: opening SG egress reduces NATGW sessions but still increases egress cost unless we use privatelink. agree keep it short.
linh: we also pushed a small conntrack tunable on the NAT instances to increase max: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=200000` but it's a stopgap. need design fix.
sara: commands we used to triage:
```
sudo conntrack -S | grep entries
sudo dmesg | tail -n 50
kubectl get nodes -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}{" "}{.status.conditions[?(@.type==\"Ready\")].status}{"\n"}{end}'
```
michael: TF snippet for the temporary SG rule (with expiry):
```
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "tmp_auditshipper_allow" {
  type        = "egress"
  from_port   = 443
  to_port     = 443
  protocol    = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks = ["10.21.4.0/24"]
  description = "temp allow auditshipper -> keystore s3; expires: 2026-03-21T10:00:00Z"
  tags = {
    "compliance" = "temporal"
    "incident" = "INC-20260321-77"
  }
}
```
linh: followup: we'll need keystore team to accept the privatelink endpoint policy. @sara can you loop them in?
sara: looped @keystore-team via email; they asked for the endpoint ARN and policy draft.
dan: longer term fixes: 1) route keystore traffic over privatelink by default for eu regions, 2) add conntrack pressure alert at 50k, 3) reduce default warmup audit sampling to 0.1 during node bootstrap, 4) firewall rollout preflight check to simulate expected flow counts.
michael: cost calc: NATGW egress for audit traffic ~ $0.09/GB + per-hour NAT instance cost. Privatelink one-time endpoint + data processing cheaper for sustained traffic. I'll add numbers to the incident doc.
linh: also flagged that SNI inspection creates new flows per TLS handshake; suggest we avoid inspection for internal service-to-service traffic to reduce churn.
sara: action items assigned in incident doc #INC-20260321-77: - michael: cost delta + update runbook, - linh: create privatelink endpoint and policy, - dan: add conntrack alert & preflight checks, - sara: LB healthcheck tweaking to avoid flapping during warmup.
ops-bot: incident-created: INC-20260321-77.
dan: temporary rollback guard idea: firewall CI should run a conntrack pressure simulator against a staging NAT to detect potential blowups.
michael: agree. we should also add a canary lane that keeps keystore privatelink enabled when we roll fw rules.
sara: thanks team. will update here once keystore policy approved and privatelink is live. :thumbsup:
